verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community hands-on benchmark showing Ollama itself running quantized model variants (q4_K_M, nvfp4, int4) via 'ollama run'. That confirms INT4-class quantized loading in the product, but there is no first-party documentation of supported quantization formats. Missing for 10: first-party docs on supported quantization formats, evidence for FP8 loading, evidence for GPTQ loading, evidence for AWQ loading.

support.subject: As a developer, I can load models quantized in formats like FP8, INT4, GPTQ, or AWQ
